about: Spoken lines by key, with how long each lasts as recorded (`seconds`; a line without one is shown, not heard, for the unvoiced time `timing` gives), residents’ exchanges with the wanderer, overheard scenes and the wanderer’s own remarks. Exchanges and scenes are booked for their lines’ lengths.
units: metres, seconds, radians; x east, z south, y up

rowan.bark.supplies.speaker: trail_hunter
rowan.bark.supplies.text: Rillford's pots are running thin. Take a bow from the bench if you need one. Bring back meat and I'll pay a fair price. Keep your hunt clear of the road.

hero.arrival.speaker: hero
hero.arrival.text: Salt in my mouth. Sand in everything. And no name to go with any of it.

hero.arrival.bell.speaker: hero
hero.arrival.bell.text: A bell, inland. Somebody is in trouble. Might as well be me who answers.

hero.place.lantern_point.speaker: hero
hero.place.lantern_point.text: A lighthouse. Dark, for now. Somebody kept it lit once.

hero.place.deepwood.speaker: hero
hero.place.deepwood.text: Old trees. Older than whatever I was.

hero.place.overlook.speaker: hero
hero.place.overlook.text: A village below. Smoke from the chimneys, at least.

hero.place.rillford.speaker: hero
hero.place.rillford.text: Rillford. The bell is louder here. So is the quiet.

hero.place.ford.speaker: hero
hero.place.ford.text: The ford. Washed out, like everything else round here.

hero.place.spring_shrine.speaker: hero
hero.place.spring_shrine.text: A shrine. The water sounds thin.

hero.place.sluice.speaker: hero
hero.place.sluice.text: So this is the sluice. Cracked, and nobody has mended it.

hero.place.quarry.speaker: hero
hero.place.quarry.text: A quarry with no cutting. That is a lot of people standing still.

hero.place.archive.speaker: hero
hero.place.archive.text: Shelves of records. Somebody kept count of everything except me.

hero.blade.speaker: hero
hero.blade.text: A rusted blade. Better than bare hands. Barely.

hero.wounded.2.speaker: hero
hero.wounded.2.text: [breathing hard] I need to rest. Soon.

hero.respawn.1.speaker: hero
hero.respawn.1.text: [exhales] Still breathing. Let us not do that again.

hero.settled.speaker: hero
hero.settled.text: The bell has changed. Either I fixed something, or I broke it properly.

hero.night.speaker: hero
hero.night.text: Dark already. The road looks longer at night.

hero.dawn.speaker: hero
hero.dawn.text: Morning. Still no name. Still breathing.

hero.rescued.speaker: hero
hero.rescued.text: She is safe. One thing done right today.

hero.shortcut.speaker: hero
hero.shortcut.text: The old gate is open. A way round, without a fight.

hero.rite.speaker: hero
hero.rite.text: [exhales] The water is calmer. For now.

hero.gate.stabilized.speaker: hero
hero.gate.stabilized.text: Braced and turning. It will hold.

hero.gate.jammed.speaker: hero
hero.gate.jammed.text: [sighs] Jammed. That one is on me.

hero.inspect.arrival_wreckage.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.arrival_wreckage.text: A boat, once. Did I come in it? I cannot even tell you that.

hero.inspect.templar_waymarker.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.templar_waymarker.text: Notches in the stone. Someone wanted this path found.

hero.inspect.dry_channel.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.dry_channel.text: Dry to the mud. A whole village drinking from one well.

hero.inspect.spring_sediment.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.spring_sediment.text: Silt. The spring still wells up underneath it. Choked, not dead.

hero.inspect.town_diversion.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.town_diversion.text: A fresh cut in the bank. Somebody helped themselves.

hero.inspect.quarry_seep.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.quarry_seep.text: Water where it should not be, and rock cracked where it was cut too far.

hero.inspect.sluice_crack.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.sluice_crack.text: That stone will not hold if anyone forces the gate. Careful hands, then.

hero.inspect.inspection_log.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.inspection_log.text: A week missing, right before the flood. Convenient. Or careless.

hero.inspect.wetland_fish.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.wetland_fish.text: The shallows are drying out. The fish knew before anyone did.

hero.inspect.saltward_kit.speaker: hero
hero.inspect.saltward_kit.text: A level and a marked staff. Somebody knew how to share this water, once.

hero.item.archive_key.speaker: hero
hero.item.archive_key.text: A key to a room full of other people’s memories.

hero.item.votive_reed.speaker: hero
hero.item.votive_reed.text: One reed. One chance. Do not waste it.

hero.item.sluice_brace.speaker: hero
hero.item.sluice_brace.text: A brace for the cracked post. Now to set it without breaking anything.

hero.item.gate_wrench.speaker: hero
hero.item.gate_wrench.text: Heavy. Good. The gate will need persuading.

hero.item.coin.speaker: hero
hero.item.coin.text: Coin. Whoever I was, I will need some of this.

hero.item.healing_herb.speaker: hero
hero.item.healing_herb.text: Bitter-smelling leaves. Probably good for something.

hero.item.shore_apple.speaker: hero
hero.item.shore_apple.text: Salt on the skin of it. Still an apple.

hero.ask.ashore.speaker: hero
hero.ask.ashore.text: Did you see me come ashore?

hero.ask.places.speaker: hero
hero.ask.places.text: Where are the sluice and the shrine?

hero.ask.diversion.speaker: hero
hero.ask.diversion.text: The side gate above the fields. That was you?

hero.ask.wait.speaker: hero
hero.ask.wait.text: Why not wait for the water?

hero.ask.down.speaker: hero
hero.ask.down.text: How do I get you down?

hero.ask.gully.speaker: hero
hero.ask.gully.text: What did you see in the gully?

hero.ask.close.speaker: hero
hero.ask.close.text: How should the gate be closed?

hero.ask.late.speaker: hero
hero.ask.late.text: And if the delivery is late?

hero.ask.me.speaker: hero
hero.ask.me.text: What will you write about me?

hero.ask.darin.speaker: hero
hero.ask.darin.text: What is Darin like to work for?

hero.ask.village.speaker: hero
hero.ask.village.text: How is the village holding up?

joss.where.speaker: caravan_master
joss.where.text: The overlook above Rillford, friend. You came up from the strand on foot? Nobody comes up from the strand. Sit a moment before you fall over.

joss.ashore.speaker: caravan_master
joss.ashore.text: [chuckles] I saw a man walk out of the surf like it owed him money. Did not seem polite to ask.

joss.bell.speaker: caravan_master
joss.bell.text: Rillford’s drought bell. They ring it when the household channels run dry, and nobody rings it lightly. It has been going since dawn.

joss.work.speaker: caravan_master
joss.work.text: Ask for the reeve, Mara Venn. East there is a quarry under a Marcher contract, north a Templar spring. Work enough for spare hands, and arguments to go with it.

joss.road.speaker: caravan_master
joss.road.text: The ford road washed out in the thaw, so the wagon waits here. If you walk down, watch the side path off the ford. Something big has been about.

joss.roads.speaker: caravan_master
joss.roads.text: East to the ford, if the ford were standing. Further on, the Marcher estates, and folk who would charge you for the dust on your boots.

joss.beast.speaker: caravan_master
joss.beast.text: They say the thornback is dead. Then I will take the cut road home, and thank whoever did it.

joss.after.speaker: caravan_master
joss.after.text: I heard the bell ring differently this morning. Whatever you did down there, it carried up the hill.

joss.idle.speaker: caravan_master
joss.idle.text: Wagon is not going anywhere yet. Neither am I.

joss.bark.horse.speaker: caravan_master
joss.bark.horse.text: Easy, old girl. The road will dry.

joss.bark.fog.speaker: caravan_master
joss.bark.fog.text: Morning. Fog is lifting off the strand.

joss.bark.lamp.speaker: caravan_master
joss.bark.lamp.text: [yawns] Lamp is low. So am I.

mara.intro.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.intro.text: You heard the bell, then. It has not rung in my term until today. I am Mara Venn. Rillford elected me to keep it fed, and this morning I have very little to feed anyone with.

mara.water.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.water.text: The late thaw broke the old sluice and choked the spring channels with silt. The household channel behind the mill is dry. Go and see it.

mara.who.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.who.text: The quarry wants it for cutting, the shrine wants its share, and I cannot give all three what each is owed.

mara.places.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.places.text: North along the mill lane to the sluice. Past it, up the steps, the spring shrine. The quarry is east, along the cut track.

mara.channel.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.channel.text: You have seen the channel, then. Now you know why I ring that bell myself, some mornings.

mara.choose.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.choose.text: If it comes to one or the other, I would choose the village, and I will not pretend otherwise. That is why it should not be my choice alone.

mara.diversion.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.diversion.text: [sighs] Yes. I opened it when the channel first ran short, and I called no witnesses. I told myself it was too small to matter. It is not nothing.

mara.hear.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.hear.text: Talk to Darin and to Sister Edda before you decide anything. I would rather you heard all of us than only me.

mara.after.rillford.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.after.rillford.text: The channel behind the mill is filling. I can hear it. It cost the quarry, and I know it. We will owe a review.

mara.after.quarry.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.after.quarry.text: The mill sits still and the households still ration. I said I would abide by your choice, and I will. But Rillford is protesting, and so am I.

mara.after.rotation.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.after.rotation.text: Mill by day, quarry by night. Neither of us has what we asked for. That is what fair looks like, I suppose.

mara.bark.bucket.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.bark.bucket.text: A bucket a day. That is what I promised them.

mara.bark.bread.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.bark.bread.text: Water in the channel. Bread by the weekend.

mara.bark.short.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.bark.short.text: Let us hear it, then. Who is short today?

mara.scene.cansee.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.cansee.text: I can see that, Bess. I am standing in it.

mara.scene.counting.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.counting.text: [sighs] Everybody is counting. That is the trouble.

mara.scene.hear.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.hear.text: I hear it. Do not waste a drop.

mara.scene.broken.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.broken.text: Only that it is still broken.

mara.scene.three.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.three.text: Then three will have to do. I am sorry, Hesper.

mara.scene.share.speaker: rillford_reeve
mara.scene.share.text: Smaller ones, Hesper. We still share.

edda.intro.speaker: spring_steward
edda.intro.text: You have the look of someone walking since dawn. I am Sister Edda Sorn, waterkeeper of this spring. It still gives what it can. It is the channels below that have failed.

edda.failing.speaker: spring_steward
edda.failing.text: It is not failing. Silt obstructs it. If you doubt me, kneel at the intake and put your hand in.

edda.gate.speaker: spring_steward
edda.gate.text: The support beside the gate cracked in the flood. I would not force that gate open. It could give way.

edda.accord.speaker: spring_steward
edda.accord.text: An old agreement between the village, the order and the land. It says who may take water, and that someone must always watch who takes it.

edda.rite.ask.speaker: spring_steward
edda.rite.ask.text: A votive reed, a few words, and patience. It calms an unstable flow for perhaps forty minutes. Long enough to work a gate safely. No longer.

edda.rite.speaker: spring_steward
edda.rite.text: The rite calms an unstable flow for a while. It does not make water. It makes a gate less violent.

edda.log.speaker: spring_steward
edda.log.text: [exhales] You have read my log. Yes, I deferred the inspection. I trusted old stone, and the stone did not deserve it.

edda.after.rotation.speaker: spring_steward
edda.after.rotation.text: A schedule witnessed by the reeve, the foreman and the spring. This is what the Accord meant. I will not miss another inspection.

edda.after.speaker: spring_steward
edda.after.text: The wetland has its minimum. An emergency allocation lapses unless it is reviewed, and I will hold the review.

edda.bark.patience.speaker: spring_steward
edda.bark.patience.text: Patience. The water remembers its way.

edda.bark.reeds.speaker: spring_steward
edda.bark.reeds.text: Mind the reeds. They were here before any of us.

edda.bark.blessed.speaker: spring_steward
edda.bark.blessed.text: Blessed is the water that finds its way home.

edda.bark.light.speaker: spring_steward
edda.bark.light.text: The light goes early at the spring.

darin.intro.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.intro.text: Quarry is stopped. No water to cut with, less to drink. Darin Kest. If the reeve sent you to shut me down, save your breath.

darin.wait.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.wait.text: I have a Marcher contract and a delivery that will not wait on the weather. The estate counts blocks, not excuses.

darin.marchers.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.marchers.text: Stone, on time, and no stories about why it is late. Halvek writes the numbers. I am the one who has to make them true.

darin.ila.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.ila.text: Ila Rusk went along the cut path to read the seep gully, and something big took the path from her. There is an old maintenance gate. Its lever is by the lower stack.

darin.lever.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.lever.text: Old gate, older lever. Lower stack, east side of the yard. It sticks. Pull like you mean it.

darin.seep.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.seep.text: We cut a short extension after the permission ran out. The seep came after. My crew reported it. Nobody came.

darin.safe.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.safe.text: Ila is down safe? [exhales] Good. She is stubborn, but she is the best eye for rock I have got.

darin.after.quarry.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.after.quarry.text: Water in the cutting trench again. The delivery goes out. I will not thank you for the look on the village’s face, mind.

darin.after.rotation.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.after.rotation.text: Nights for us, days for the mill. The crew hates it, and they will do it.

darin.after.rillford.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.after.rillford.text: Quarry is stopped. My crew is unpaid and idle. The estate will have my hide for this.

darin.bark.count.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.bark.count.text: Forty blocks. I can count, Halvek.

darin.bark.stack.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.bark.stack.text: Who is minding the lower stack?

darin.bark.edge.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.bark.edge.text: [shouts] Mind the edge! I am not losing anyone else this season.

darin.bark.ledgers.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.bark.ledgers.text: Ledgers. I would rather lift stone.

darin.scene.blocks.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.scene.blocks.text: [shouts] Pell Dunmore! Those blocks will not square themselves.

darin.scene.well.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.scene.well.text: Then fetch water from the well.

darin.scene.load.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.scene.load.text: [shouts] Load the cart! The steward is counting.

darin.scene.used.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.scene.used.text: [laughs] Do not get used to it.

ila.ledge.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.ledge.text: Keep back from the path! A thornback took the ledge below, and it does not like company. I am Ila Rusk, seasonal maintenance.

ila.down.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.down.text: There is an old maintenance gate. The lever is by the quarry’s lower stack. Pull it, and I can walk the old track round the ledge.

ila.notnow.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.notnow.text: Not now! Get me off this ledge first, then I will tell you everything.

ila.waiting.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.waiting.text: Still here. Still counting the same three handholds.

ila.saw.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.saw.text: My legs have forgotten how to be legs. Here is what I saw up there: fresh fractures on the support beside the gate, and the seep feeding the wrong channel.

ila.close.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.close.text: Slowly, from the downstream side. Brace the cracked post first, then a quarter turn of the wheel, and wait for the water to settle.

ila.from.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.from.text: Rimeward. Up north, where the rivers freeze solid and nobody argues about water. They argue about everything else.

ila.stay.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.stay.text: Until my legs remember they are legs. Then wherever there is stone that needs reading.

ila.villain.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.villain.text: Do not look for a villain. Look for who will keep the pieces from failing again.

ila.bark.down.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.bark.down.text: [whispers] Do not look down, Ila. Do not look down.

ila.bark.bench.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.bark.bench.text: Warm bench. Dry boots. I could weep.

ila.bark.cheerful.speaker: maintenance_worker
ila.bark.cheerful.text: Somebody play something cheerful, before I remember the ledge.

oren.intro.speaker: estate_steward
oren.intro.text: Steward Halvek, Marcher estate. If you are here about the delivery, the contract stands regardless of who has water.

oren.reserve.truth.speaker: estate_steward
oren.reserve.truth.text: [clears throat] It is empty. The estate has not funded repairs since the winter levy. Please do not repeat that.

oren.owns.speaker: estate_steward
oren.owns.text: The Marcher estate holds the contract. The crown holds the estate. I hold the ledger, which is the only part anyone ever reads.

oren.late.speaker: estate_steward
oren.late.text: Penalties. Then excuses. Then a new steward. I would prefer to avoid the third.

oren.date.speaker: estate_steward
oren.date.text: The delivery date has not moved. Is there something else?

oren.after.quarry.speaker: estate_steward
oren.after.quarry.text: The delivery will go out. The estate notes your part in it. That is not a promise of anything.

oren.after.speaker: estate_steward
oren.after.text: The estate is reviewing its commitments. A missed delivery reflects on my ledger, not yours. Good day.

oren.bark.columns.speaker: estate_steward
oren.bark.columns.text: Columns that do not add up. How familiar.

oren.bark.counting.speaker: estate_steward
oren.bark.counting.text: Thirty-eight. Thirty-nine. And none since Tuesday.

sel.intro.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.intro.text: Sel Anrit, recorder. Third failure this season: a bridge, a granary road, now the water. You will call it coincidence. I do not.

sel.write.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.write.text: Everything. Including an old rotation ledger in the shrine archive. The copies disagree. If you can read it, read it.

sel.witness.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.witness.text: We write down what happens, so that later no one can say it happened differently. We take no side. That is the hardest part.

sel.me.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.me.text: That you arrived without a name, and asked good questions. The rest, you have not done yet.

sel.pattern.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.pattern.text: Repair only delays it. Each failure is smaller than the last cause, and larger than the last cure.

sel.after.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.after.text: I have written down what you did. I do not yet know whether it is a beginning or a delay. But it is written.

sel.bark.ink.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.bark.ink.text: The ink dries slowly today. Damp air.

sel.bark.hour.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.bark.hour.text: Name, place, hour. Always the hour.

sel.bark.river.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.bark.river.text: The river was higher, once. I have it written.

sel.bark.dark.speaker: ash_recorder
sel.bark.dark.text: Too dark to write. Not too dark to remember.

tolan.intro.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.intro.text: Warden Tolan Harrow. The archive is locked, and Sister Edda holds the say. State your business.

tolan.archive.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.archive.text: Records older than the village. The order keeps them. Few read them, and fewer put them back.

tolan.see.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.see.text: Not without the Sister’s word. Bring me that, and I will turn the key myself.

tolan.templar.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.templar.text: Sworn to the order for thirty years. These days that means sweeping roots off a doorstep and turning away the curious.

tolan.guard.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.guard.text: If you want steel discipline rather than speeches, I teach a little of it. Feet apart, guard high, and do not flinch.

tolan.after.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.after.text: The Sister says the water is fair now. I say keep the gate braced and the log honest.

tolan.bark.hands.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.bark.hands.text: Hands where I can see them, pilgrim.

tolan.bark.lock.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.bark.lock.text: [sighs] Another night, another lock to check.

tolan.bark.along.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.bark.along.text: Move along, pilgrim. The spring is that way.

bess.intro.speaker: mill_hand
bess.intro.text: The wheel has been dry since the flood. Without water I have nothing to grind. I stand here so the reeve sees somebody is minding it.

bess.mill.speaker: mill_hand
bess.mill.text: Water in the channel behind it, that is all. Half a channel would do. A quarter, even. I am not proud.

bess.grain.speaker: mill_hand
bess.grain.text: [laughs] Since you ask: in sacks, going nowhere. Thank you for asking. Nobody else has.

bess.built.speaker: mill_hand
bess.built.text: My grandmother’s grandmother, if you believe my grandmother. The wheel is younger. Only just.

bess.after.rillford.speaker: mill_hand
bess.after.rillford.text: [laughs] She turns! Grain by evening, and the whole village will smell the flour.

bess.after.speaker: mill_hand
bess.after.text: Still dry. I will keep standing here. Somebody should.

bess.bark.grain.speaker: mill_hand
bess.bark.grain.text: Go on, ask me how the grain is doing.

bess.scene.counting.speaker: mill_hand
bess.scene.counting.text: Just making sure somebody is counting.

pell.intro.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.intro.text: Foreman says we wait. Nothing to cut with, nothing to drink.

pell.ila.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.ila.text: Ila is up the cut path. Something big took the ledge. Foreman knows about the gate.

pell.darin.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.darin.text: Loud. Honest, mind. He shouts the same at the crew as at the steward. Only the steward shouts back.

pell.sleep.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.sleep.text: Crew bunks behind the yard. Four of us, two blankets. We take turns being cold.

pell.after.rotation.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.after.rotation.text: [sighs] Night shift again. Night shift of what? Staring at rocks in the dark?

pell.after.quarry.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.after.quarry.text: Load the wagon. Quickly, before somebody changes their mind.

pell.bark.dust.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.bark.dust.text: Dust in my teeth and nothing to wash it down.

pell.scene.dry.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.scene.dry.text: Nothing to square them with, foreman. The trench is dry.

pell.scene.count.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.scene.count.text: Let him count. We are cutting again.

hesper.intro.speaker: village_baker
hesper.intro.text: No water, no dough, my love. If you have not looked at the dry channel behind the mill, do.

hesper.help.speaker: village_baker
hesper.help.text: Take a loaf, you look like you need it. Then go and help the reeve. You cannot ask a bucket to do a river’s work.

hesper.bake.speaker: village_baker
hesper.bake.text: Rye loaves, when there is water. Flatbread when there is not. Prayers when there is neither.

hesper.village.speaker: village_baker
hesper.village.text: Tired and polite, mostly. Polite will not last, love. Get the water moving before it does not.

hesper.after.rillford.speaker: village_baker
hesper.after.rillford.text: Bread by the weekend, and not a day later. I have promised half the village already.

hesper.after.speaker: village_baker
hesper.after.text: Smaller loaves this week. Everybody understands. Nobody likes it.

hesper.bark.step.speaker: village_baker
hesper.bark.step.text: [laughs] Mind the step, love, it is floury.

hesper.bark.barrel.speaker: village_baker
hesper.bark.barrel.text: Last of the rain barrel, this.

hesper.bark.queue.speaker: village_baker
hesper.bark.queue.text: Who is for the well? Mind the queue.

hesper.scene.word.speaker: village_baker
hesper.scene.word.text: [calls out] Mara! Any word from the sluice?

hesper.scene.flour.speaker: village_baker
hesper.scene.flour.text: I can stretch the flour three more days. Not four.

hesper.scene.quick.speaker: village_baker
hesper.scene.quick.text: Do not be sorry, love. Be quick.

bess.bark.wheel.speaker: mill_hand
bess.bark.wheel.text: The wheel has not turned since the flood.

pell.bark.nothing.speaker: quarry_hand
pell.bark.nothing.text: Nothing to cut with. Nothing to drink.

darin.bark.contract.speaker: quarry_foreman
darin.bark.contract.text: Contract does not care about the weather.

tolan.bark.lamp.speaker: shrine_warden
tolan.bark.lamp.text: Keep the lamp out of the archive.

oren.bark.date.speaker: estate_steward
oren.bark.date.text: The delivery date has not moved.
